meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘并推送数据快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 NanoClaw 并需要可视化运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard and push data snapshots to NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and need to visualize its runtime status

howto.what: 它会为 NanoClaw 安装 npm 包和 pusher 模块,在 src/index.ts 加入启动代码,并配置 DASHBOARD_SECRET/DASHBOARD_PORT;之后面板可显示会话、用户、token 用量与实时日志等。
howto.when: 当你说“给 NanoClaw 加仪表盘/监控面板”,或要求接入 @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard 时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上监控仪表盘
say.note: 会安装 dashboard 包并接入启动流程。

say.text: 帮我配置 DASHBOARD_SECRET 和端口,然后启动面板
say.note: 设置环境变量并重启服务。

say.text: 在 NanoClaw 里加一个能看 token 用量和实时日志的面板
say.note: 安装 pusher 并展示对应页面。

howto.what_en: Installs a local monitoring dashboard for NanoClaw: npm package, pusher module, startup block in src/index.ts, DASHBOARD_SECRET/DASHBOARD_PORT. UI shows groups, sessions, channels, users, token usage, context windows, live logs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a monitoring dashboard to a NanoClaw project, or to wire in @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Installs the package and wires it into startup.

say_en.text: Configure DASHBOARD_SECRET and a port, then restart.
say_en.note: Sets env vars and restarts the service.

say_en.text: Add a dashboard that shows token usage and live logs.
say_en.note: Installs the pusher and enables those pages.
